description: Audit the active sequence in one read-only bridge request for empty timelines, primary-track gaps, disabled clips, muted tracks, and excessive Motion scale. Structural diagnostics only; it cannot judge story, framing, sound, or final delivery.

gap_tolerance_seconds.description: Ignore smaller gaps caused by time rounding (default: 0.001)

maximum_scale_percent.description: Warn above this Motion scale percentage (default: 110)

primary_video_track.description: Video track used for gap inspection (default: 0)
